audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called the lane flatly EVEN across all stages; it is a three-phase lane — Orianna 1-3, Katarina 4 through first item, Orianna again at two items.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and the content win[] column both invert at 2+ items, and it is grounded: Command: Shockwave is a 110s ult at rank 1 that directly answers a reset fight, while her lane weakness is a ball with travel time and no dash.
audit.corrected: Bank the lead between 4 and first item; the late game is hers and the page should say so.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose named no timing and breakdown.cooldowns had no digit — the packet also flagged zero sequencing cues anywhere in this matchup.
audit.why: Command: Attack is 7s at rank 1 and 3s at rank 5; Command: Dissonance is a flat 7s; Command: Protect is a flat 9s; Command: Shockwave is 110/95/80s.
audit.corrected: Concrete sequencing added: engage on ball position, not on a timer, and commit inside the 110s R downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was written as 'track the ball position like a second enemy' with no statement of why that matters mechanically.
audit.why: Every Orianna ability originates at the ball, not at Orianna. Command: Shockwave has only 410 range from the ball and launches after a short delay, and Death Lotus is a channel any CC cancels — so the ball's location, not her position, decides whether your R survives. Her E shield absorbs burst but is a flat 9s and covers one spell, not a five-piece string.
audit.corrected: Engage when the ball is on the wave or travelling back; that is the window where Shockwave physically cannot reach you.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2].t reads 'All-in into spell-shield kits unbroken' — Orianna has no spell shield.
audit.why: Her only defensive layer is Command: Protect (E), a shield plus armour/MR on a 9s cooldown. Calling it a spell shield tells the reader to wait for a break that never comes.
audit.corrected: Retitled to the real defensive layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: 12 lint findings: 8 misgenders (Orianna is she/her), 2 copy-paste bleeds, 1 digit-free cooldowns field; plus the packet's fabricated 'Command Attack-Dissonance' in early.
audit.why: Deterministic lint output plus packet suspectNames.

edits.before: No-CC mages are lunch and CC mages are landlords — know which one he is before the first dagger drops.
edits.after: Her whole kit fires from the ball, not from her — engage when it is on the wave and she has no answer at all.

edits.before: Bait the answer, then blend the mage who spent it. Track Command: Shockwave before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.
edits.after: Win the game between level 4 and your first item. Track the ball, not Orianna — if it is away from her body, Command: Shockwave cannot reach you.

edits.before: Orianna wins by landing Command: Shockwave, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Orianna wins by surviving to two items and grouping — one Command: Shockwave on your reset attempt ends the fight you started.

edits.before: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — steel-routed trades his aim can't follow.
edits.after: She shoves with Q-W and the ball is stranded on the wave — E in then, full string, and walk out before it flies home.

edits.before: Shunpo onto a face with the CC still loaded — Katarina dies to held buttons, not skill, and everyone holding one knows it.
edits.after: Walking up while the ball hovers at her feet — that is Q, W's slow field and empowered autos all loaded on one spot.

edits.before: Ahead, chain it: zone Orianna off daggers, lotus every skirmish, and reset through the map — fed Katarina is a weather event.
edits.after: Ahead, end early: she has no dash and the slowest follow-rotation of any control mage, so roam off every shove and close the game.

edits.before: Dagger geometry and patience — chip the no-CC kits, bait the CC ones, and bank patterns for the 6 that changes the lane's species.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are hers: Command: Attack is 7s at rank 1 and her auto range is long. Bounce-farm from range and arrive at level 4 healthy.

edits.before: First item onward, hunt skirmishes: every 2v2 near your daggers is a reset chain waiting for a signature. Roam when mid stalls.
edits.after: Levels 4 to first item is your whole game: engage on a stranded ball, and roam off shoves she cannot follow without a dash.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-bounced thin push with daggers banked at the river mouth — your roams arrive with luggage. Worst wave: a frozen wave near a CC mage's tower — every pickup walk is a stun audition. Crash timing: the crash is a timer you set — reset, plate, or roam, but never just because.
edits.after: Best wave: one she has just shoved with Q-W, because the ball is sitting in the minions and not on her. Worst wave: frozen at her tower, where every pickup walk crosses Dissonance's slow field. Crash timing: crash and leave — she pushes back slowly and follows slower, so the roam is free.

edits.before: - Orianna Command: Shockwave: matchup-defining — The fight-flipping wombo — track the ball position like a second enemy. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Shunpo (second use) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Command: Shockwave (R): 110s at rank 1, and only 410 range from the BALL — if the ball is on the wave, it cannot touch you. - Command: Attack is 7s at rank 1 and 3s at rank 5; Dissonance and Protect are flat 7s and 9s. - Shunpo's second use answers the delay on her R.

edits.after: Good trade: she shoves with Q-W and the ball is stranded on the wave — E in then, full string, and walk out before it flies home. Bad trade: walking up while the ball hovers at her feet, since that is Q, W's slow field and empowered autos all loaded on one spot.

edits.before: If Orianna gets one kill, respect Command: Shockwave and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with Q bounces and stay relevant through reset potential.
edits.after: If Orianna gets one kill, stop walking into ball range and farm the Q bounce from outside 815. Two kills: her lane simply outlasts you, so give up the solo answer, group early, and make her spend a 110s Shockwave on someone other than you.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
edits.after: You carry on a clock — every kill before two items counts double, because after that her Shockwave answers the reset fight.

edits.before: You are the cleanup that starts fights: enter on steel, lotus the clump, reset through the kill, and exit through the panic.
edits.after: Force her R with a shallow entrance or let a bruiser draw it, then commit the real Lotus — and hunt her in side rotations.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 she bullies you: Command Attack-Dissonance poke plus her huge auto range means every walk-up toward CS costs health, and pre-full-kit you can't answer. Take Q-bounce farm from range, keep the wave near your side, and never trade while the ball hovers at her feet — that's when her burst and Attack empowered autos are all loaded. Sustain runes or a Dark Seal refillable carry you through this stretch; your job is to hit level 4 healthy.
